title: Software Engineer
description:
About The Company

Nuro is a leading technology company dedicated to transforming the way goods are delivered through innovative autonomous vehicle solutions. With a strong commitment to safety, sustainability, and customer satisfaction, Nuro develops cutting-edge autonomous delivery vehicles that are designed to operate efficiently in various urban environments. The company's mission is to make local commerce easier, faster, and more accessible by leveraging advanced robotics and AI technologies. Nuro's team comprises passionate professionals from diverse backgrounds who work collaboratively to push the boundaries of autonomous mobility and create impactful solutions that benefit communities worldwide.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Autonomous Vehicle Software Engineer to join our dynamic team at Nuro. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing the software systems that enable our autonomous vehicles to operate safely and efficiently. You will work closely with cross-disciplinary teams including hardware engineers, AI specialists, and product managers to deliver innovative solutions that enhance vehicle performance and user experience. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in robotics, computer vision, or related fields, along with a passion for advancing autonomous technology. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that are shaping the future of urban logistics and transportation.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; a master’s degree or higher is preferred. Demonstrated experience in developing software for autonomous systems, robotics, or automotive applications is essential. Proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, or ROS (Robot Operating System) is required. Knowledge of sensor integration, computer vision, and machine learning techniques is highly desirable. Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, and excellent communication skills are also important. Prior experience with simulation tools and real-world deployment of autonomous systems will be considered a plus.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain software components for autonomous vehicle systems, including perception, localization, planning, and control modules.
Collaborate with hardware and AI teams to integrate sensors, actuators, and machine learning models into the vehicle platform.
Implement and optimize algorithms to improve vehicle safety, reliability, and efficiency under various operational conditions.
Conduct extensive testing and validation of software systems through simulation and real-world trials.
Participate in code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in autonomous vehicle technology and incorporate best practices into development processes.
Support troubleshooting and debugging of software issues encountered during development and deployment phases.

Benefits

Nuro offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance coverage, and retirement plans. Employees have access to flexible working hours and remote work options to promote work-life balance. We also provide opportunities for continuous learning and development through training programs, workshops, and conferences. Additionally, Nuro fosters an inclusive and collaborative work environment where innovation and diversity are valued. Employees are encouraged to contribute ideas and participate in initiatives that drive the company’s mission forward. We believe in recognizing and rewarding hard work, dedication, and innovative contributions that make a tangible impact on our community and industry.

Equal Opportunity

Nuro is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse perspectives and backgrounds strengthen our team and drive innovation. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status. We are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to our shared mission of transforming urban logistics through autonomous technology.
